scope: Seven assigned language banks; targeted corrections, not full certification

changes.issue: Singular they made a second option defensible
changes.evidence: Test agreement and participle form without rejecting singular they.

choices: Each of the employees is required to submit his or her report.
Each of the employees are required to submit his or her report.
Each of the employees is require to submit their reports.
Each of the employees are required to submit their reports.
revised_fields.explanation: 'Each' takes the singular verb 'is'; 'is required' uses the past participle. Singular 'their' is also standard, but it does not repair the verb errors in the other choices.

changes.issue: More simple is not universally incorrect
changes.evidence: Merriam-Webster lists simpler/simplest. Removed the competing more simple option and the false universal one-/two-syllable rule; this is a focused rewrite rather than a claim that all analytic comparatives are invalid.

choices: This procedure is simplest than the previous one.
This procedure is more simpler than the previous one.
This procedure is simpler than the previous one.
This procedure is most simpler than the previous one.
revised_fields.explanation: 'Simpler' is the comparative used here. 'More simpler' and 'most simpler' improperly combine comparative markers; 'simplest' is a superlative. 'More simple' can also occur in standard English.

changes.evidence: Several employees explicitly requires plural possession.

revised_fields.question: The lounge belongs to several employees. Choose the sentence that correctly shows this plural possession.
revised_fields.explanation: The plural noun 'employees' ends in s, so its possessive adds an apostrophe after s: employees'. The singular employee's would refer to one employee.

revised_fields.question: Choose the sentence that uses the correct indefinite article before "honest public servant".

changes.issue: Singular and plural possessives both grammatical
changes.evidence: Plural possessive requirement selects women’s.

revised_fields.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses the plural possessive of "woman".

changes.evidence: Use agreement/complete-sentence distractors without falsely rejecting accepted dialect variants or revealing the requested preposition in the stem.

revised_fields.question: Choose the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement and a complete comparison.
choices: His approach are different from mine.
His approach is differ from mine.
His approach is different from mine.
revised_fields.explanation: The singular subject "approach" takes "is", followed by the adjective "different" and the comparison "from mine". The other choices use the wrong verb agreement, use "differ" after "is", or omit the finite verb. "Different to" and "different than" can also be accepted constructions, so they are not treated as incorrect distractors.

changes.evidence: Stem now explicitly requests courtesy convention.

revised_fields.question: Which sentence uses an objective pronoun and the conventional courteous ordering that places the other person first?
revised_fields.explanation: Both "to me and Maria" and "to Maria and me" use the objective pronoun correctly. This question also requests the conventional courteous ordering, which places Maria first.

changes.issue: Quantity is valid with count nouns
changes.evidence: Remove valid alternative.

revised_fields.explanation: The noun "number" fits "a large number of books". The other options do not form the required noun phrase. "Quantity of books" is also grammatical, so it is not used as a distractor.

changes.evidence: Test verb agreement without rejecting singular their.

choices: Each of the students has his or her own laptop.
Each of the students having their own laptop.
Each of the students have their own laptop.
Each of the students have his or her own laptop.
revised_fields.explanation: "Each" takes the singular verb "has". Singular "their" is also standard; the other choices fail because they lack a finite verb or use "have" with "each".

changes.evidence: Requested object comparison excludes valid subject comparison.

revised_fields.question: Which sentence correctly means "She likes him more than she likes me"?
revised_fields.explanation: "Than me" expresses the requested comparison between two people she likes. "Than I" can mean "than I do", comparing how much two people like him, which is a different meaning. "Then" is not the comparison word.

revised_fields.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng "balatkayo" sa pahayag na "Balatkayo lamang ang kaniyang kabaitan"?
revised_fields.explanation: Sa pangungusap, ang "balatkayo" ay pagkukunwari: hindi tunay ang ipinakikitang kabaitan.

revised_fields.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng "umaalingasaw" sa pangungusap na "Umaalingasaw ang basurang hindi nakolekta"?

changes.evidence: RA 9003 section 48(3) prohibits open burning of solid waste.

revised_fields.question:
Basahin ang talata at sagutin ang tanong.

Ang Republic Act No. 9003 o ang Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000 ay isang batas na naglalayong itaguyod ang wastong pamamahala ng basura sa Pilipinas. Inaatasan nito ang mga lokal na pamahalaan na magpatupad ng mga programa sa pag-segregate, pagkolekta, at wastong pagtatapon ng basura. Ipinagbabawal din ng batas ang hayagang pagsusunog ng solid waste (open burning). Layunin ng batas na ito na mabawasan ang mga basurang napupunta sa mga landfill at maprotektahan ang kapaligiran.

Ano ang ipinagbabawal ng RA 9003 ayon sa talata?
choices: Pagtatapon ng basura sa tamang lugar
Pagkolekta ng basura ng lokal na pamahalaan
revised_fields.explanation: Ipinagbabawal ng Seksyon 48(3) ng RA 9003 ang open burning ng solid waste, na siyang binanggit sa talata.

changes.evidence: Maharap sa expresses facing a case; harapin requires an actor who confronts an object.

revised_fields.question:
Basahin ang talata at sagutin ang tanong.

Ang paggalang sa karapatang pantao ay isang pangunahing prinsipyo ng isang demokratikong lipunan. Ang bawat tao ay may karapatang mabuhay nang malaya, magpahayag ng kanilang opinyon, at maging ligtas mula sa anumang uri ng diskriminasyon. Iginagalang ng Saligang Batas ng Pilipinas ang mga karapatang ito at pinoprotektahan ang mga mamamayan laban sa pang-aabuso ng kapangyarihan. Ang mga lumalabag sa karapatang pantao ay maaaring maharap sa mga kaso sa korte.

Ano ang maaaring mangyari sa mga lumalabag sa karapatang pantao ayon sa talata?
choices: Maaari silang maharap sa mga kaso sa korte
revised_fields.correct_answer: Maaari silang maharap sa mga kaso sa korte
revised_fields.explanation: Ayon sa talata, ang mga lumalabag sa karapatang pantao ay maaaring maharap sa mga kaso sa korte.

changes.evidence: CSC lists special eligibility routes including bar/board and honor graduates.

revised_fields.question:
Basahin ang talata at sagutin ang tanong.

Ang serbisyo sibil sa Pilipinas ay binubuo ng mga empleyado ng pamahalaan na nagsisilbi sa bayan. Ang pagpasa sa Civil Service Examination na ibinibigay ng CSC ay isang paraan upang makamit ang career service eligibility. May iba pang paraan ng pagkamit ng eligibility, gaya ng mga kinikilala ng CSC para sa mga honor graduate at mga nakapasa sa bar o board examination. Ang eksamen ay sumusubok sa mga kakayahan sa verbal, numerical, at analytical reasoning, pati na rin sa kaalaman sa Saligang Batas at mga batas na may kaugnayan sa serbisyo publiko. Ang angkop na eligibility ay isa lamang sa mga kuwalipikasyon para sa mga posisyong nangangailangan nito.

Aling paraan ng pagkamit ng career service eligibility ang inilalarawan sa talata?
revised_fields.explanation: Inilalarawan ng talata ang pagpasa sa Civil Service Examination bilang isang paraan ng pagkamit ng eligibility, at kinikilala rin nito ang ibang paraan.

changes.evidence: Focused comprehension rewrite retains constitutional guarantee under Article III section 4 without asserting an unsupported categorical exclusion.

revised_fields.question:
Basahin ang talata at sagutin ang tanong.

Ginagarantiya ng Saligang Batas ng Pilipinas ang kalayaan sa pagsasalita, pagpapahayag, at pamamahayag. Sa responsableng paggamit ng kalayaang ito, sinusuri ng isang manunulat ang katotohanan ng kaniyang impormasyon bago maglathala. Itinatama niya ang mga pagkakamali at malinaw niyang ibinubukod ang opinyon sa napatunayang impormasyon.

Alin ang halimbawa ng responsableng pagpapahayag ayon sa talata?
revised_fields.explanation: Binanggit ng talata ang pagsusuri ng katotohanan ng impormasyon bago ito ilathala bilang responsableng paggamit ng kalayaan sa pagpapahayag.
